title: INDoS WG3 Training School 2026: structural and diffusion MRI materials
description: Teaching materials on structural MRI (FreeSurfer, voxel-based morphometry) and diffusion MRI, prepared for the Training School of Working Group 3 of the INDoS COST Action (CA24161), Madrid, 30 September to 2 October 2026: the slides of both lectures (PDF) and the Jupyter notebooks of the hands-on sessions, with their setup guide.

creators.name: Alemán-Gómez, Yasser
creators.affiliation: Lausanne University Hospital and University of Lausanne, Switzerland

notes: This publication is based upon work from COST Action CA24161 (INDoS), supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology).
